sentences.text: This writ petition is filed seeking the following prayer:

"...declaring the inaction of the respondent No.2 in referring the petitioners representation dated 29.10.2008 received on 03.11.2008 in proceedings No.AA/1400/2007 dated 05.09.2008 to competent court under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional and consequently direct the respondent no.2 to refer the petitioners representation dated 29.10.2008 received on 03.11.2008 in proceedings No.AA/1400/2007 dated 05.09.2008 to competent Court under section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act 1894."
2. Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this Court in similar circumstances in W.P.No.22878 of 2013 dated 26.02.2024 has disposed of the writ petition with a direction to respondents to refer the Award therein to the Competent Civil Court under Section 18 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as per representation of the petitioner therein.
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays this Court to pass similar order.
3.
Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition reports no objection in passing similar orders.

4. In such view of the matter, recording submissions of learned counsel on either side, this Writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent authorities to refer the Award dated 05.09.2008 to the competent Civil Court under Section 18 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for enhancement of compensation as per the representation of the petitioner dated 29.10.2008 within a period of two (2) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As sequel to it, Miscellaneous Petitions, if any pending, shall stand dismissed.

___ ________________________ N.V.SHRAVAN KUMAR, J 10.04.2025 mrm Manish Bhatia vs The Government Of Andhra Pradesh on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131918623/
